content: W3C WAI cognitive accessibility (updated 2024-04-25) summarizes applicable WCAG needs: adaptable structure, distinguishable foreground/background, enough time, navigability, readable language, predictable operation, and error assistance; additional Content Usable guidance encourages user-involved design/testing. WCAG consistent navigation means repeated mechanisms maintain relative order. This supports consistent shell, clear location/progress cues and plain language across screens; distinguish standard requirements from supplemental guidance. Medium confidence: official primary guidance.
